title: Spies Sent to Canaan

questions.question: How many spies were sent to Canaan?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:2 (ESV): "Send men to spy out the land of Canaan... one man from each... tribe."

questions.question: Who represented the tribe of Judah?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:6 (ESV): "From the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh."

questions.question: Who represented the tribe of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:8 (ESV): "From the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun."

questions.question: What did they bring back from the Valley of Eshcol?
options: A branch with a single cluster of grapes carried on a pole
questions.correctAnswer: A branch with a single cluster of grapes carried on a pole
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:23 (ESV): "Cut down from there a branch with a single cluster of grapes, and they carried it on a pole..."

questions.question: How long did they spy out the land?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:25 (ESV): "At the end of forty days they returned from spying out the land."

questions.question: What was the report of the ten spies regarding the land?
options: It flows with milk and honey, but the people are strong
questions.correctAnswer: It flows with milk and honey, but the people are strong
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:27-28 (ESV): "It flows with milk and honey... However, the people who dwell in the land are strong..."

questions.question: Who constituted the "giants" (Nephilim) they saw?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:33 (ESV): "And there we saw the Nephilim (the sons of Anak... and we seemed to ourselves like grasshoppers."

questions.question: Who tried to quiet the people before Moses?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:30 (ESV): "But Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, 'Let us go up at once and occupy it...'"

questions.question: What did the bad report say about the land devouring?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:32 (ESV): "The land... is a land that devours its inhabitants..."

questions.question: What name did Moses give to Hoshea son of Nun?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:16 (ESV): "And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua."

questions.question: From where were the spies sent?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:3 (ESV): "So Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran..."

questions.question: Which other fruits did they bring besides grapes?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:23 (ESV): "They brought also some pomegranates and figs."

questions.question: Who was the spy from Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:9 (ESV): "From the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu."

questions.question: Where was Hebron located (mentioned as being built 7 years before Zoan)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:22 (ESV): "They went up into the Negeb and came to Hebron... Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt."

questions.question: What does "Eshcol" mean?
questions.explanation: Numbers 13:24 (ESV): "That place was called the Valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster that the people of Israel cut down..."

key_verse_text: But Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, 'Let us go up at once and occupy it, for we are well able to overcome it.'
